column5: What if a volcano erupted in the middle of your city?
Lava bursts out at over one thousand degrees.
An ash cloud rises kilometers into the sky.
It's tiny shards of rock and glass.
And the deadliest part… a cloud of hot gas and ash races down the streets at up to seven hundred kilometers per hour.
Most lava moves slowly enough to walk away from.
In 1943, a volcano was born in a Mexican cornfield… and grew fifty meters in one day.
Auckland, New Zealand, is built on top of about fifty volcanoes.
